method: Authored and reviewed by hand from each pinned peer's own rule file (the same revisions benchmarks/detector-inventory.json snapshots: the Gitleaks config, the TruffleHog detector sources, the flare-redact spec and the OpenRedaction package patterns). A rule targets a family when its pattern, with the keyword gate or wrapper it requires, can match a credential of that family, or it is the peer's rule for that credential class. Never derived from what a peer found on the fixtures. A rule for the same provider but another token class is not mapped. Rules whose name looks like a provider are either mapped or listed in reviewedNoFamily with the reason; validated by benchmarks/lib/peer-rule-families.ts.

aws-access-token.basis: AKIA, ASIA, ABIA or ACCA + 16 characters

aws-amazon-bedrock-api-key-short-lived.basis: bedrock-api-key- + the Base64 pre-signed URL prefix

curl-auth-header.basis: curl -H Authorization Bearer, Basic or Token value

generic-api-key.basis: keyword-before-value assignment with a literal of 10 or more characters

openai-api-key.basis: sk-proj-, sk-svcacct- or sk-admin- with the T3BlbkFJ marker

slack-user-token.basis: xoxp- or xoxe- + three digit groups + 28-34 characters

sonar-api-token.basis: sonar login or token keyword + squ_, sqp_ or sqa_ + 40 characters

sourcegraph-access-token.basis: sgp_ (optionally with a 16-hex or local instance identifier) + 40 hex, or a bare 40 hex

square-access-token.basis: EAAA or sq0atp- + 22-60 [\w-], entropy 2 (a wider window than EAAA + 60; sq0atp- is a scanner-only form)

stripe-access-token.basis: sk_ or rk_ + test, live or prod + 10-99 characters

reviewedNoFamily.1password-secret-key: the account Secret Key (A3-...), a different credential from the service account token family
reviewedNoFamily.cloudflare-api-key: a 40-character legacy key beside a cloudflare keyword; the taxonomy family is the cfut_ scannable token (53 characters), which this pattern cannot match
reviewedNoFamily.cloudflare-global-api-key: a 37-character hex global API key; the taxonomy family is the cfut_ scannable token
reviewedNoFamily.cloudflare-origin-ca-key: an origin CA key (v1.0-...), not the cfut_ scannable token
reviewedNoFamily.confluent-access-token: the 16-character Cloud API key ID, an identifier and not the API secret
reviewedNoFamily.discord-api-token: a 64-hex value beside a discord keyword, not the three-segment bot token
reviewedNoFamily.discord-client-id: an OAuth application id, not a credential family in the taxonomy
reviewedNoFamily.discord-client-secret: an OAuth client secret, not the bot token
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-cicd-job-token: a GitLab CI/CD job token (glcbt-); the taxonomy has no family for it
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-deploy-token: a GitLab deploy token (gldt-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-feature-flag-client-token: a GitLab feature flag client token (glffct-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-feed-token: a GitLab feed token (glft-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-incoming-mail-token: a GitLab incoming mail token (glimt-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-kubernetes-agent-token: a GitLab Kubernetes agent token (glagent-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-oauth-app-secret: a GitLab OAuth application secret (gloas-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-ptt: a GitLab pipeline trigger token (glptt-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-rrt: a GitLab runner registration token (GR1348941); the taxonomy family is the runner authentication token
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-scim-token: a GitLab SCIM token (glsoat-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab-session-cookie: a GitLab session cookie; not a token family
reviewedNoFamily.grafana-api-key: a legacy Grafana API key (eyJrIjoi); the taxonomy families are the glsa_ and glc_ tokens
reviewedNoFamily.hashicorp-tf-password: a password assignment in Terraform files, not a Terraform Cloud API token
reviewedNoFamily.huggingface-organization-api-token: the api_org_ prefix, a different token class from hf_ access tokens
reviewedNoFamily.linear-client-secret: an OAuth client secret beside a linear keyword, not the personal API key or the OAuth access token
reviewedNoFamily.mapbox-api-token: reads the public pk. token (keyword-gated, 60 + 22 lowercase alphanumerics); the secret sk. token is the family and this rule does not read it
reviewedNoFamily.microsoft-teams-webhook: a webhook URL, not a credential family in the taxonomy
reviewedNoFamily.new-relic-browser-api-token: a browser key (NRJS-); the taxonomy families are the NRAK- user key and the license key
reviewedNoFamily.new-relic-insert-key: an insert key (NRII-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.new-relic-user-api-id: a 64-character user id beside a newrelic keyword; not the NRAK- user API key
reviewedNoFamily.sentry-access-token: a 64-hex value beside a sentry keyword, not the sntryu_ or sntrys_ prefixed tokens
reviewedNoFamily.shopify-custom-access-token: the shpca_ prefix; the taxonomy's custom app token is shpat_
reviewedNoFamily.shopify-shared-secret: an app shared secret (shpss_), not an access token
reviewedNoFamily.slack-config-access-token: a configuration access token (xoxe.xoxb- or xoxe.xoxp-); the taxonomy families are the xoxb-, xoxp- and xapp- tokens
reviewedNoFamily.slack-config-refresh-token: a configuration refresh token (xoxe-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.slack-legacy-token: a legacy xoxo- or xoxs- token; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.slack-legacy-workspace-token: a legacy xoxa- or xoxr- workspace token; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.slack-webhook-url: a webhook URL; the taxonomy's workflow webhook family is the xwfp- token
reviewedNoFamily.squarespace-access-token: Squarespace is another provider (a keyword-gated UUID)
reviewedNoFamily.twilio-api-key: the SK API key SID, a public identifier the taxonomy excludes (docs/specs/taxonomy.md); the 32-character secret is not matched

aws/access_keys.basis: AKIA, ABIA or ACCA id, reported with its paired secret

aws/session_keys.basis: ASIA id + a session token of 100 or more characters

buildkite/v2.basis: bkua_ + 40 [a-z0-9] (the API access token role only)

datadogtoken.basis: datadog or dd keyword + 32 or 40 characters

doppler.basis: dp.st., dp.pt., dp.ct., dp.sa., dp.scim. or dp.audit. + 40-44 characters

gcpapplicationdefaultcredentials.basis: application default credentials JSON with a client_secret

github/v2.basis: ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_ or github_pat_ + 36-255 characters

hashicorpvault/hashicorpvaultbatchtoken.basis: hvb. token, with a HashiCorp Cloud URL

hashicorpvault/hashicorpvaulttoken.basis: hvs. token, with a HashiCorp Cloud URL

mailgun.basis: key- + 32 characters, or a 32-8-8 hex triplet

mongodb.basis: mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// URI with a password

postgres.basis: postgres:// or postgresql:// URI with a password

sourcegraph.basis: sgp_ (optionally with a 16-hex or local instance identifier) + 40 hex, or a bare 40 hex

squareapp.basis: (sandbox-)sq0c?? + 40-50 [0-9A-Za-z_-]; the same detector also reads sq0i?? application ids (public identifiers)

twilio.basis: 32 hex beside an AC account SID

twilioapikey.basis: SK key SID + a 32 character secret

uri.basis: http(s) URL with a userinfo password

reviewedNoFamily.atlassian/v1: a 24-character legacy token beside an atlassian keyword; the taxonomy families are the ATAT-prefixed tokens
reviewedNoFamily.atlassiandatacenter/bitbucketdatacenter: a Bitbucket Data Center token; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.atlassiandatacenter/confluencedatacenter: a Confluence Data Center token; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.atlassiandatacenter/jiradatacenterpat: a Jira Data Center personal access token; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.azure_openai: an Azure OpenAI resource key, a different credential from the OpenAI secret API key
reviewedNoFamily.buildkite/v1: reads a bare 40-character [a-z0-9] run after the word buildkite, a legacy shape no handoff role claims
reviewedNoFamily.cloudflareapitoken/v1: a 40-character legacy key beside a cloudflare keyword; cannot match the cfut_ scannable token
reviewedNoFamily.cloudflarecakey: an origin CA key, not the cfut_ scannable token
reviewedNoFamily.cloudflareglobalapikey/v1: a global API key beside a cloudflare keyword, not the cfut_ scannable token
reviewedNoFamily.cloudflareglobalapikey/v2: a global API key (cfk_), not the cfut_ scannable token
reviewedNoFamily.digitaloceantoken: an unprefixed 64-character token beside a digitalocean keyword; the taxonomy families are the dop_v1_, doo_v1_ and dor_v1_ tokens, which this pattern cannot match at 71 characters
reviewedNoFamily.discordwebhook: a webhook URL, not the bot token
reviewedNoFamily.elevenlabs/v1: a legacy 32-hex key beside an elevenlabs keyword; the taxonomy family is sk_ + 48 hex
reviewedNoFamily.github/v1: a 40-hex legacy token beside a github keyword; the taxonomy families are the prefixed tokens
reviewedNoFamily.github_oauth2: an OAuth application client id and 40-hex client secret; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.githubapp: a GitHub App id and RSA private key; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.gitlab/v1: an unprefixed 20-22 character legacy token beside a gitlab keyword; the taxonomy family is glpat- prefixed
reviewedNoFamily.gitlaboauth2: a GitLab OAuth application secret (gloas-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.hashicorpvaultauth: an AppRole role id and secret id; no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.honeycomb: a 32-hex or 22-character key beside a honeycomb keyword; the taxonomy family is the hc?ik_ 64-character ingest key
reviewedNoFamily.microsoftteamswebhook/v1: a webhook URL, not a credential family in the taxonomy
reviewedNoFamily.microsoftteamswebhook/v2: a webhook URL, not a credential family in the taxonomy
reviewedNoFamily.netlify/v1: a 43-45 character key beside a netlify keyword; the taxonomy families are 40-character nf-prefixed tokens
reviewedNoFamily.newrelicbrowserkey: a browser key (NRBR-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.newrelicinsightsinsertkey: an insert key (NRII-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.newrelicinsightsquerykey: a query key (NRIQ-); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.newrelicmobileapptoken: a mobile app token (-NRMA); no taxonomy family
reviewedNoFamily.newrelicpersonalapikey: a 47-character personal key beside a newrelic keyword; the taxonomy family is the 32-character NRAK- key
reviewedNoFamily.sentrytoken/v1: a 64-hex value beside a sentry keyword, not the sntryu_ or sntrys_ prefixed tokens
reviewedNoFamily.shopifyoauth: an app shared secret (shpss_) and client id, not an access token
reviewedNoFamily.slackwebhook: a webhook URL; the taxonomy's workflow webhook family is the xwfp- token
reviewedNoFamily.sourcegraphcody: the Cody Gateway slk_ token is not the sgp_ personal access token (the handoff leaves sgd_ for a later extension)
reviewedNoFamily.vercel: a 24-character legacy token beside a vercel keyword; the taxonomy's modern families are the vcp_, vca_, vcr_, vci_ and vck_ tokens, and the compatibility aggregate is a routing row, not a credential class

github_token.basis: ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_, ghr_ + 36 or github_pat_ + 82 characters

square_token.basis: sq0 + three letters + - + 22-43, or EAAA + 60 [A-Za-z0-9_-]; the sq0i?? alternatives are public application ids

stripe_key.basis: sk_ or rk_ + live or test + 16-64 characters

reviewedNoFamily.discord_webhook: a webhook URL, not the bot token
reviewedNoFamily.sentry_dsn: a DSN URL with a public key; not a token family
reviewedNoFamily.twilio_key: the AC account SID and SK key SID, public identifiers the taxonomy excludes

DATABASE_CONNECTION.basis: postgres, mysql, mongodb, redis or sqlite URI with a password

GENERIC_API_KEY.basis: api key keyword + a value of 20 or more characters

GENERIC_SECRET.basis: password, passwd, pwd or secret keyword + a value of 8 or more characters

GITHUB_TOKEN.basis: ghp_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_ or ghr_ + 36 or more characters

OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.basis: client secret or consumer secret keyword + 20 or more characters

OAUTH_TOKEN.basis: oauth token or access token keyword + 20 or more characters

SLACK_TOKEN.basis: xoxb- or xoxp- + 10 or more characters

STRIPE_API_KEY.basis: sk_ + live or test + 24 or more characters

URL_WITH_AUTH.basis: http(s) or ftp URL with user:password@
